title: Build the project-docs lineage graph
description: Scans the workspace for project-docs/ artifacts and project-docs-ancestors references across code and docs, and writes the resulting graph to .nx-agent/lineage.json (gitignored). Broken references and YAML parse errors are recorded in the output rather than aborting the write. Run with --dry-run to check without writing, --strict to fail the command on a violation, or --json to print the graph to stdout for a machine consumer.

strict.description: Fail the command when a reference is broken or frontmatter is unparseable, instead of only recording it in the output. Nx rolls a generator's staged write back when it throws, so a failing --strict run deliberately produces no lineage.json — use it as a gate, not to build the graph.

json.description: Print the graph to stdout as one JSON document instead of the human-readable summary, for a machine consumer. Pair it with --quiet, or Nx's own "NX Generating ..." banner lands on stdout ahead of the document. Same object that's written to the file, and printed before --strict throws, so --json --strict is the one invocation that yields both the graph and a failing exit code in a single run.
